compatibilityOverlays: resolve-library-id accepts an omitted query and derives a minimal safe query
get-library-docs maps legacy arguments to query-docs
prompts/list, resources/list, and resources/templates/list return empty compatibility lists when upstream does not implement them

tools.name: resolve-library-id
tools.description: Resolve a package or product name to a Context7-compatible library ID.

libraryName.description: Official library, framework, SDK, API, CLI, or cloud-service name.

query.description: Sanitized user question or task used to rank library results. Optional for old app callers.

tools.name: query-docs
tools.description: Fetch and query current Context7 documentation for a selected library ID.

libraryId.description: Exact Context7-compatible library ID returned by resolve-library-id.

tools.name: get-library-docs
tools.description: Compatibility action for older Context7 app callers. Maps to query-docs.

tokens.description: Compatibility field accepted for older callers.
